programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: The action of the series begins in 52 BC.Gaius Julius Caesar conquered Gaul.He returns to Rome with thousands of loyal soldiers and a plan for change.The aristocracy is frightened by Caesar's strength.Out of fear, he is threatened with charges of war crimes.Caesar's friend and mentor, Pompey the Great, tries to incite a rebellion to maintain power.Two of Caesar's soldiers, Lucius Vorenus and Titus Pullo, foil Pompey's plans.This is how they gain the trust of Caesar and his family.From then on, the lives of these legionaries and Caesar, Mark Antony, Cleopatra and the young Octavius ​​Gaius, in the future Octavian the Great, the first emperor of Rome, intertwine.The soldiers become witnesses of great events taking place in the times of Julius Caesar.The latest series produced by HBO was nominated for this year's Golden Globes in two categories: best television series and best female role in a drama series (Polly Walker) Chasing Pompey, Caesar reaches Africa.There he pays a visit to twelve-year-old Ptolemy XIII.She demands that he end the conflict with Cleopatra.Wanting to gain Caesar's favor, Ptolemy gives him the head of Pompey as a gift.However, such treatment of the consul outraged the Roman ruler.Finally, Caesar decides to resolve the Egyptian power dispute himself.He sends Pullus and Vorenus to search for the imprisoned Cleopatra, whom Ptolemy's advisors decide to kill.Vorenus and Pullo manage to save her at the last moment.On the way to Alexandria, Cleopatra intends to get pregnant and then convince Caesar that the child is his.Pullo complies with the queen's orders with satisfaction.Cleopatra's return means the imprisonment of her brother and the death of his advisors.The outraged supporters of the very young ruler begin to occupy the palace.Cleopatra gives birth to a son, whom she names Caesarion.

programme.desc: Two-day road trip to the beautiful spots in all the corners of Korea! Instead of fancy studio, this on-the-road reality show takes place in the rural sides. While over 10 million Koreans travel abroad each year, the '2 Days and 1 Night' casts travel around Korea - to the mountains, farms, fishing villages, islands - where you can meet the welcoming smiles of our neighbors and the beautiful nature that cleanse our eyes.

programme.desc: Four legendary Korean professional baseball players take on a new challenge as coaches of U-10 youth baseball teams. They may be masters of the game, but as coaches, they are complete rookies starting from zero. programme.title: Jang Youngsil: The Greatest Scientist Of Joseon
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it.

Now Natasha is the owner of a music label and has the power to make Vicky a global phenomenon. While Vicky, who is still with Anjali, wants to keep things professional, Natasha isn't about to take no for an answer.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: The second largest continent on Earth is distinguished by an impressive fauna that occurs only in this part of the world.It is crossed by huge water arteries.They shape a diverse landscape and constitute a source of life and shelter.Documentary filmmakers show the extent to which animals depend on rivers.They capture spectacular views.They follow the trail of African giants - such as elephants, hippos, crocodiles and leopards.They take viewers to a world where even the most powerful beings overcome numerous challenges every day to survive.The arena of the fight for survival The filmmakers follow the trail marked, among others, by the Zambezi, the Nile and the Ogowe.Life thrives around these rivers.Herds of elephants bathing, hippos basking in the sun and perfectly camouflaged crocodiles create an image of peace and harmony.However, it can be deceptive.Only the fittest will survive here.The cameras captured, among other things, a hunting scene of a crocodile waiting motionlessly for its unwary prey.Apart from the majestic giants, the film features other, no less interesting characters who chose different survival strategies.Among them are the civet, the silent and elusive leopard, the porcupine, and Africa's largest eagle, called the armed warrior.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: A story about the untamed forces of nature, danger and natural wonders that can be discovered in the wildest regions of America.Viewers, together with the creators of the series, will visit Everglades National Park, the Grand Canyon, Death Valley, Glacier National Park and Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park.Even though all these places seem to be well-known and explored, each of them hides its own secrets.A journey in the footsteps of wild America will go far beyond guidebooks.Areas will be explored where humans are still guests and must absolutely obey the rules of nature.

programme.title: Animal Genius
programme.desc: Biologist Liz Bonnin has been revealing the secrets of the fauna kingdom for years.In this film, he observes animals that are very good at fighting predators, even though they do not have sharp claws and fangs.Their survival is related to skills such as communication and cooperation.It turns out that nature still hides many secrets from us.The observed animals surprise scientists who make new discoveries.This time they will learn patents for survival, including:in Africa and Mexico.There is strength in a herd. Charming meerkats have already been the heroines of many documentaries and TV series.Curious mammals living in the Kalahari Desert are exposed to attacks by predators.They can inform each other about various threats.Their characteristic sound signals are crucial.Viewers will also watch the battle between Matabele warrior ants and termites.Unusual insects can provide first aid to injured companions.In Mexico, Liz Bonnin will observe sea turtles.The small reptiles face a dangerous journey to the ocean.They move towards the water together, increasing their chances of survival.These scenes show that in nature, it is not only the strongest who survive, but also the best connected.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: We discover eight different species of octopuses in the depths of the sea.Each has a unique personality and great intelligence.Despite drastic differences, these animals turn out to be surprisingly similar to humans.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: In this episode we will see animal hunters carefully preparing a battle plan.We will see that an attacker's intelligence can make the difference between victory and death.We will see, among other things, how hyenas hunt and how they deal with the leader who acted to the detriment of the herd.We will also witness a hungry cheetah trying to catch a savannah gazelle.She decides to take a desperate step - she runs away to a river full of crocodiles.They will have a feast, the big cat must enjoy it this time.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: The territory of North and South America stretches over 15,000 kilometers - from the Arctic Archipelago to Tierra del Fuego.No other continent has such breadth and diversity of landscape.Here you can admire the longest mountain chain in the world - the Andes, the Amazon rainforest and the driest area on Earth - the Atacama Desert.Unique species of animals live in these wild areas.The authors hunt grizzly bears, encounter bats with extremely long tongues, jaguars attacking caimans and dolphins swimming among the trees.From cold Alaska, through the tropical Caribbean and the green Amazon - famous actor Josh Brolin takes viewers on this amazing journey.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom: Uprising
programme.desc: The film is dedicated to a lion named Sekekama.He is the undisputed leader of the pack.However, to maintain power, he must defend his throne against his rivals.These are three eastern princes who want to rule the entire territory.They are ready to overthrow the current king, and each of them may pose a real threat to his position.A new, powerful empire is also created by the dangerous Queens of the North.Three lionesses were once expelled from the pride, and now they tirelessly plan bloody revenge on their enemies.Meanwhile, the lioness Saba struggles with a personal tragedy.At the same time, she constantly works to ensure that the only son she has will follow the path she has set In distant Botswana, a fierce battle between the lion dynasty is taking place.Animals conspire, plot, plan coups, commit treason and protect their heirs with dedication.The four-episode documentary series brings to mind dramas whose heroes are people.On the African plains, the story of kings, their traitorous sons and mysterious avengers comes to life.The background of the bloody games are stunning landscapes, captured using the latest filming technology.Viewers can see both lightning in the stormy sky above the plain and individual dewdrops on the lion's mane.Game of Thrones One of the main characters of this story, created five years ago, is the aging lion Sekekama.He must constantly guard his position in the herd.He has enemies even among his descendants.In addition, warrior lionesses appeared on the outskirts of his territory, which the authors of the document called the Queens of the North.Three females and eight cubs are able to create a new dynasty that will take over the area.Saba the leopard will also play an important role in the whole story, as she tries to instill the hunter's instinct in her son and teaches him the art of killing.

programme.desc: The documentary presents the history of "Area 51", an air military base located in the desert near Las Vegas.The base was established in 1955, but its existence was officially confirmed only in 2013.This place is shrouded in legends because it is surrounded by a prohibited air zone of 1,140 square kilometers.The base developed programs that determined American dominance in military aviation from the Cold War to operations in Iraq and Afghanistan.Spy planes tested there were often mistaken for UFOs.The film features eyewitnesses to the creation of subsequent super-secret projects.Declassified CIA documents were used in the production.

programme.title: After Earth
programme.desc: People were forced to leave Earth a millennium ago to establish a new home on Nova Prime. Now, Gen. Cypher Raige (Will Smith) heads Nova Prime's most-prominent family. Cypher's teenage son, Kitai (Jaden Smith), feels enormous pressure to follow in his father's legendary footsteps -- which strains their relationship. Cypher and Kitai set out on a trip to mend their bond, but when their craft crashes on Earth's hostile surface, each must trust the other greatly -- or perish.

programme.title: Daniela Forever
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: Southpaw
programme.desc: Billy "The Great" Hope (Jake Gyllenhaal), the reigning junior middleweight boxing champion, has an impressive career, a loving wife and daughter, and a lavish lifestyle. However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis (Forest Whitaker), a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers. With his future on the line, Hope fights to reclaim the trust of those he loves the most.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.desc: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: A series of reports presenting the customs and life situation of women living in distant corners of the globe.Journalist Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.Stops in the third edition of the program include Samoa, Ghana and India.Together with her interlocutors, she experiences their joys and sorrows and participates in everyday activities.This allows her to understand contrasts and learn about different approaches to femininity in different parts of the world While traveling through picturesque Polynesia, Martyna Wojciechowska meets another fascinating heroine.In Samoa, the role one plays in the community is more important than gender and appearance.Boys can decide whether they want to become men and heads of the family, or choose a different life scenario - become fa'afafine.This term describes people who combine features of both sexes.Martyna visited Vaitoe Toelupe, a 26-year-old fa'afafine who is responsible for coordinating rescue services in the event of various disasters, and after work she designs women's clothes.Alex K'Sua, on the other hand, is the first fa'afafine lawyer in Samoa's history.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world This time, Martyna Wojciechowska travels through Asia and Europe, wanting to learn the story of the youngest heroine so far.First, he stops in Hong Kong, where Hanson Robotics is headquartered.The most recognizable humanoid robot - Sophia, was created there.The host follows her to London.He intends to check why the android arouses such extreme emotions.This "woman" has dated Will Smith, sung with Jimmy Fallon, made a speech at the UN meeting, and has been photographed on the covers of numerous magazines.Although it is not the most modern machine in the world, it still causes controversy and provokes discussion regarding artificial intelligence.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world Martyna Wojciechowska visits Canada.Matricia Bauer, who lives in the heart of Jasper National Park in the Rocky Mountains, tells her story.Locals know her as a guide, leader and drum artist.She is a representative of the Kri people.When she was five years old, she was separated from her family as part of a government program called the '60s captive.It involved placing thousands of children from indigenous communities up for adoption by middle-class white families.It was about assimilation with the West.Another example of colonization were boarding schools, where cultural genocide occurred.About 150,000 people lost their childhood there.Frieda, Marticia's mentor, went to one of such places.It proves that even despite tragic experiences, you can find the strength to discover your own identity and then defend it.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world At first glance, Brazil is very open, but in fact it is a country full of contrasts.Violence and macho culture are a brutal everyday reality for many here.For over a decade, it has been at the top of the shameful statistics regarding the murders of transgender people.Over a hundred people die there every year because of transphobia.During her next trip, Martyna Wojciechowska visits Fortaleza, where Lara Nicole lives.She is an activist who opposes the violence prevalent in the world and fights for her own rights and those of other transgender people.She dreams of living to the age of forty, while the average life expectancy of transgender people in Brazil is thirty-five years.Faced with social exclusion, nearly 90% of transgender women have to work on the streets.They remain vulnerable to all forms of violence.For this reason, Lara created Casa Transformar - a safe place for people from the LGBTQ+ community.They can get support.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world This time Martyna goes to Florida, which is Americans' favorite place to spend their retirement.They move there to spend the autumn of their lives walking along the seaside and watching sunsets.However, for the heroines of this episode - Donna and her bandmates - this is definitely not enough.The Calendar Girls group consists of thirty women aged 52 to 82.The women were united by their passion for dance and physical activity.They meet for training several times a week and take part in almost 200 performances a year.With their colorful and joyful repertoire, they entertain residents of retirement homes and financially support the training of guide dogs.The heroines of the episode prove that old age is joy.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world Martyna Wojciechowska visits Canada.Matricia Bauer, who lives in the heart of Jasper National Park in the Rocky Mountains, tells her story.Locals know her as a guide, leader and drum artist.She is a representative of the Kri people.When she was five years old, she was separated from her family as part of a government program called the '60s captive.It involved placing thousands of children from indigenous communities up for adoption by middle-class white families.It was about assimilation with the West.Another example of colonization were boarding schools, where cultural genocide occurred.About 150,000 people lost their childhood there.Frieda, Marticia's mentor, went to one of such places.It proves that even despite tragic experiences, you can find the strength to discover your own identity and then defend it.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world At first glance, Brazil is very open, but in fact it is a country full of contrasts.Violence and macho culture are a brutal everyday reality for many here.For over a decade, it has been at the top of the shameful statistics regarding the murders of transgender people.Over a hundred people die there every year because of transphobia.During her next trip, Martyna Wojciechowska visits Fortaleza, where Lara Nicole lives.She is an activist who opposes the violence prevalent in the world and fights for her own rights and those of other transgender people.She dreams of living to the age of forty, while the average life expectancy of transgender people in Brazil is thirty-five years.Faced with social exclusion, nearly 90% of transgender women have to work on the streets.They remain vulnerable to all forms of violence.For this reason, Lara created Casa Transformar - a safe place for people from the LGBTQ+ community.They can get support.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: The program returns to the air after a break.Over the last few months, Martyna Wojciechowska and her team have traveled all over the world to look for inspiring women who will talk about what is currently most important.For some topics, the host had to wait many years, but for the good stuff, it's definitely worth it.The latest season will bring meetings with the oldest and youngest heroines in the history of the show.Viewers will see episodes shot in eight countries and on five continents.However, it is not about records or the number of kilometers traveled.The most important thing is meeting another person, time spent together, intimate conversation, and the truth about the world This time Martyna goes to Florida, which is Americans' favorite place to spend their retirement.They move there to spend the autumn of their lives walking along the seaside and watching sunsets.However, for the heroines of this episode - Donna and her bandmates - this is definitely not enough.The Calendar Girls group consists of thirty women aged 52 to 82.The women were united by their passion for dance and physical activity.They meet for training several times a week and take part in almost 200 performances a year.With their colorful and joyful repertoire, they entertain residents of retirement homes and financially support the training of guide dogs.The heroines of the episode prove that old age is joy.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off on another journey around the United States.Together with cameraman Bebek, he will lie on the beaches in Miami, see historic plantations in Georgia and party in the clubs of New Orleans.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: New Orleans is known as the most haunted city in America.You can feel magic in the air, and you can meet fairies and witches on the streets.Marcin will take advantage of the prophecy of a local soothsayer and learn about his future. He will also meet a real Voodoo Prince!In addition, the host will try local donuts and make some great bigos... In this episode, Marcin will show viewers all the faces of New Orleans.He will visit the partyiest street, Bourbon, dance to jazz music, take part in a spectacular swingers' parade, and even start a party on the ship.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: The fun never stops in New Orleans.This dancing city is, above all, the cradle of jazz - music resounds here from morning to evening, creating an amazing atmosphere, and artists from all over the world hang out in cafes and pubs.Colorful buildings and narrow streets give the city a unique character and thus become an attractive setting for film productions.There is also no shortage of different colors on Frenchmen Street, where Marcin can try on an original suit.Also expect a bit of poetry on the way to Miami!However, before we get there, Marcin will have to find his black, mechanical horse...

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop goes on a trip to the east coast of the United States.He will visit, among others:Ohio, Cleveland, New York, the White House will watch.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: This time Marcin Prokop visits the furthest reaches of the United States: Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.What distinguishes them from the rest of the country is not only their location, but also cultural gaps and different mentalities.In the frosty corners of the North, local inhabitants, like their ancestors, live in rhythm with the seasons and in harmony with nature.Their lives often take place in one apartment building, which serves as a city.In Hawaii, in the heart of commercial tourism, local dance masters are trying to pass on to young generations a philosophy of life consistent with the spirit of aloha.It is also a paradise for the development of spiritual and artistic communities who try to live outside the system, in harmony with nature and according to their own rules.However, Puerto Rico, a Caribbean island devastated by a hurricane, formally belongs to the US, but is neither a country nor a state.Its inhabitants fight for their independence and the right to self-determination.They create grassroots resistance movements, alternative communities, ecovillages and new ways of life, cultivating ancestral history and local pride Marcin continues his expedition in Alaska, visiting places where the descendants of Inuit and Russians still fight to preserve their identity.In the tiny village of Ninilchik and the town of Eklutna, he meets residents who cultivate the memory of their ancestors in everyday gestures and religion.He also learns about the history of the Dena'ina tribe, which combines the tradition of building "soul houses" with Orthodox heritage.In Anchorage, Marcin participates in folk dance workshops, where various ethnic groups try to renew ancient rituals and save their culture from oblivion.The entire journey is a story about the lives and traditions of people who rely on the harsh Alaskan nature and who constantly care for their unique cultural identity.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: This time Marcin Prokop visits the furthest reaches of the United States: Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.What distinguishes them from the rest of the country is not only their location, but also cultural gaps and different mentalities.In the frosty corners of the North, local inhabitants, like their ancestors, live in rhythm with the seasons and in harmony with nature.Their lives often take place in one apartment building, which serves as a city.In Hawaii, in the heart of commercial tourism, local dance masters are trying to pass on to young generations a philosophy of life consistent with the spirit of aloha.It is also a paradise for the development of spiritual and artistic communities who try to live outside the system, in harmony with nature and according to their own rules.However, Puerto Rico, a Caribbean island devastated by a hurricane, formally belongs to the US, but is neither a country nor a state.Its inhabitants fight for their independence and the right to self-determination.They create grassroots resistance movements, alternative communities, ecovillages and new ways of life, cultivating ancestral history and local pride In Alaska, Marcin Prokop discovers Whittier - a small town between the mountains and the bay, where almost all the inhabitants live in one huge apartment building.The lack of hotels means that tourists rent rooms from tenants.One of the locals - June Miller - tells the host about this extraordinary everyday life.In the rugged landscape, wildlife is at your fingertips: musk oxen live on the farm, reindeer and bears roam the area.During a rally of camper owners, Marcin talks to the heroes about freedom, self-sufficiency and stereotypes that still affect the inhabitants of Alaska.

programme.title: Zulu (1964)
programme.desc: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programme.title: Down With Love
programme.desc: In 1962 New York City, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author.

programme.title: The Culling
programme.desc: When a group of college friends head out of town for a fun-filled long weekend, their plans change after finding a 7-year-old girl alone at an empty cafe along the highway and have no choice but to drive her home. When they arrive at her house it's quickly apparent they will have to stay the night - but what's not apparent is the living nightmare that they're about to encounter.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: A spoof on previous years' epic movies (The Da Vinci Code (2006), The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe (2005) + 20 more), TV series, music videos and celebs. 4 orphans are on an epic adventure.

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: ER doc Jessica loves her job, but not the hours. Meeting Trevor in Fiji, Jessica also strikes up a friendship with Will, co-owner of their resort. As Jessica notices how Trevor is a workaholic, she also sees that Will offers tranquility.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian’s plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn’t go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: Candid about Love
programme.desc: Laura, a gallery assistant and wannabe fine art photographer, is finally promised a spot in a Newcomer’s Showcase - but only if she can get a reclusive artist, Shane, to premiere his newest photographs at the gallery. When Laura discovers that Shane hasn’t taken a new photo in ten years, she’s determined to help him find his way back to his art whether he wants her to or not.

programme.title: Somewhere in Time
programme.desc: A Chicago playwright uses self-hypnosis to journey back in time and meet the actress whose old portrait hangs in an elegant hotel.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and intrigue ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want to get their hands on a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. She soon loses trust in those who claim they want to help her.

programme.title: Zulu Dawn
programme.desc: In 1879 South Africa, British Cape Colony administrators seek to crush the Zulus, viewing them as an obstacle to their colonial ambitions. To provoke war, they issue King Cetshwayo an impossible ultimatum, confident their rifles and artillery will ensure an easy victory. But as Lord Chelmsford’s forces chase an unseen foe, they discover near Isandlwana how gravely they’ve underestimated the Zulu nation’s skill and strength.

programme.title: Baby Obsession
programme.desc: Anna Gray is pregnant and ready to start a family with her loving husband Jon. But she has no idea that Rachel, the mother of a baby who died from SIDS when Anna babysat her years ago, has been waiting for this day, determined to take back what Anna 'took from me'.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: A spoof of 300 (2006) and many other movies, TV series/shows/commercials, video games and celebrities. King Leonidas of Sparta and his army of 12 go to war against Xerxes of Persia to fight to the death for Sparta's freedom.

programme.title: Universal Soldier: Regeneration
programme.desc: When terrorists are about to cause a nuclear disaster at Chernobyl, the only one who can stop them is Luc Deveraux, a retired Universal Soldier.

programme.title: Brazil
programme.desc: A bureaucrat in a dystopic society becomes an enemy of the state, as he pursues the woman of his dreams.
